$comment: Upstream version baseline. Every fact here was verified first-hand on 2026-09-28 from the npm registry, the GitHub tags and releases API, and the installed 0.2.0-rc.1 packages. The 0.1.5-rc.2 baseline this replaces is in git history.

selectedCommit.sourceArchiveSha256: not recorded: the source archive was not downloaded for this migration

registryChannelReality.$comment: The tag name is NOT the selection basis. On 2026-09-28 npm `latest` points at the 0.1.7 line; 0.2.0-rc.1 is reachable only through the `next` tag.

rejected.0.1.7-rc.2: the 0.1.x line the 0.2.0 release supersedes; selected 0.2.0-rc.1 as the formal update, on the user's request
rejected.0.1.5-rc.3: a patch release of the previous baseline; not adopted

node.enginesFloor: >=24.0.0 (this repository's own floor; @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.1 declares no engines)

cliIsolationContract.$comment: Re-verified in the installed 0.2.0-rc.1 CLI (lib/bin.js, lib/profile-boot, dsh-web-app/lib/startup.js) and by the Vault launcher, which boots `dsh web` with DSH_HOME, the home patch layer, --host 127.0.0.1, --port and --no-open.
cliIsolationContract.homePrecedence: explicit configured path > $DSH_HOME > ~/.dsh; blank/whitespace $DSH_HOME is ignored

launcherFlags.--profile <name>: boot the profile at $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>; `web` is a hardcoded alias
launcherFlags.--from-default-profile <name>: one-time init of a custom profile from a shipped template (web|headless|acp|sdk|sdk-minimal); shipped names cannot be used as custom targets
launcherFlags.--patch <path>: repeatable extra overlay applied after the profile layer and the home layer
launcherFlags.--dump-config: print composed profile tree and exit without booting
launcherFlags.--dump-default-config: print bundle layers only (no user layer, no --patch) and exit
launcherFlags.--dump-config-schema: print JSON Schema for profile entries and patches without mounting (new in 0.2.0)

pluginAssembly.behavior: forwards the remaining arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory; initialized on first use
pluginAssembly.profileLinker: pnpm, nodeLinker: hoisted, autoInstallPeers: false (written by profile init)

webSurfaceFlags.--port <port>: listen port; `0` lets the OS pick a free port
webSurfaceFlags.--trusted-host <authority...>: repeatable extra authority for the /api browser-trust fence
webSurfaceFlags.--no-open: do not open the default browser

webSurfaceDefaultBind.source: packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml row `webserver`: config.host = ctx.webStartup.host ?? '127.0.0.1', config.port = ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080

runtimeObservedNotes.loginRedirect: the one-time login URL answers 303 with Location `./`

isolationBoundary.verifiedIn: temporary DSH_HOME and classroom directories from scripts/dev-isolated.ts, random ports
isolationBoundary.realHomeUntouched: ~/.dsh and the long-term Vault (~/.notara/vault-runtime) were not started or modified by this migration
isolationBoundary.sharedServiceUntouched: only isolated instances were booted from the migration worktree

cliIsolationContract.settingsDocument: 0.2.0 removed $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml: an existing file is imported once into the active profile's cordis.patch.yml after the Loader settles, and renamed settings.yaml.imported. Notara 0.21.1 seeds writable display defaults in $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml; a home overlay locks those fields against UI edits (verified by the debug-toggle browser regression on 2026-09-29).

dependencyTreePolicy.$comment: The lockfile is the arbiter. Every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* dependency in package-lock.json must resolve to 0.2.0-rc.1, and @deepseek-ai/cordis to 4.0.4; a mixed release is a defect.

typescript.reason: the 0.2.0-rc.1 packages are built against TypeScript ^6.0.3 (dsh-typert-generator declares dependencies.typescript = ^6.0.3)
